data.title: 芙宁娜 · 海滨漫步与甜点时光
data.description: 海滨大道的露天咖啡座上，阳伞流苏随风轻轻摇动。芙宁娜坐在白色铸铁桌旁，黑色贝雷帽压住发梢，深蓝针织开衫的袖口贴在桌边。她一手托着脸颊，另一手举起银色甜点叉，把一小块草莓千层蛋糕送到唇边，尝到奶油后满足地眯起眼睛。
data.location: 枫丹廷海滨露天咖啡座
data.action: 坐在白色铸铁桌旁，一手托腮，另一手用银叉品尝草莓千层蛋糕。
data.lighting: clear morning sunlight and sea reflections
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, hands and dessert in frame
data.promptProse: Furina savors a forkful of strawberry layer cake while resting her cheek in her free hand at a white cast-iron waterfront table. Her navy cardigan and black beret frame narrowed, satisfied eyes. Keep both hands and the plate in the medium view, with parasol tassels overhead and sea beyond. Clear morning sun brightens the cream and fork; reflected water light flickers beneath the shaded tabletop edge.
